pick.title: Which one fits you?
pick.lede: Do not install an app just because—here is when to stay on a sheet and when to move.
pick.sheet.title: Stay with a spreadsheet if
pick.sheet.1: you only track 3–5 local bills in a single currency;
pick.sheet.2: you enjoy building custom pivot tables inside a larger household budget;
pick.sheet.3: you never need reminders on your phone or Telegram.
pick.coinio.title: Switch to Coinio if
pick.coinio.1: you keep missing annual renewals or free trial end dates;
pick.coinio.2: you pay in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, TRY, JPY);
pick.coinio.3: you want reminders in Telegram, email, Discord or Slack;
pick.coinio.4: you want Home Screen widgets without leaving CSV export behind.
pfaq.title: Spreadsheet migration questions
pfaq.switch.q: When is a subscription tracker better than a spreadsheet?
pfaq.switch.a: As soon as you have yearly plans, foreign-currency tools or trials you forget to cancel—that is where passive sheets miss renewal dates.
pfaq.import.q: How fast is adding my subscriptions from a sheet?
pfaq.import.a: With 161 built-in services, typing a name fills in the logo, category and cycle automatically—most people finish in two minutes.
pfaq.export.q: Can I still export back to Excel or CSV?
pfaq.export.a: Yes. Export subscriptions and payment history to CSV or JSON any time from Settings.
pfaq.currency.q: How does Coinio handle foreign currencies?
pfaq.currency.a: Every day Coinio fetches official European Central Bank reference rates via Frankfurter and converts each bill into your main currency.
pfaq.free.q: Is Coinio free like my spreadsheet?
pfaq.free.a: Yes. Both app.getcoinio.me and self-hosting with Docker are completely free with no ads.
